metadata.description: Mods for Claude Code, plugins built on function hooks

plugins.name: usageline
plugins.description: A status line under the prompt: context, cache hit rate, cache TTL countdown, today's spend for this project, and why a turn missed the cache. /usage prints the project ledger.

plugins.name: goal
plugins.description: Gives the model a goal tool that runs the built-in /goal: set a condition Claude keeps working toward, check it, or clear it.

plugins.name: desktop-skin
plugins.description: SCARLET LINK: a cockpit HUD skin. A boot ceremony, a band above the prompt with an original mascot reading real session figures, themed spinner words, and /skin. Draws on the desktop surface and the terminal.
